evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We introduce SecProbe, a framework for adaptive evaluation that combines Item Response Theory (IRT) with on-demand synthesis of repository-scale vulnerability-repair tasks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Compared with random and one-shot baselines, \textsc{SecProbe} achieves comparable agent ability estimates while requiring agents to solve up to 29.5\% fewer tasks.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: As one use case, we construct 353 tasks spanning six programming languages and 151 CWE types and evaluate nine frontier models with two agent harnesses.
